title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: At Bareilly International University (BIU), protecting your privacy and personal information is central to our educational commitment.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
content: At Bareilly International University, we collect personal information necessary to deliver academic counseling, process admission applications, and maintain student portal services.
Information collected includes applicant name, contact number, email, academic transcripts, entrance exam scores (NEET/JEE), and demographic details.
We also collect non-personal website analytics data such as IP address and browser type to optimize site performance.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
content: Your data is used exclusively to evaluate admission eligibility, send course updates, process fee payments, and issue academic communications.
We do not sell, rent, or lease applicant or student data to third-party marketing entities under any circumstances.

sections.title: 3. Data Security & Governance
content: BIU implements strict administrative, technical, and encryption safeguards to protect student records in compliance with Indian higher education regulations.
